limitations: This is a development-only diagnostic until confirmed on untouched examples.
Convergence-based stopping bounds optimization effort but does not prove a converged global optimum was reached.
Only eight development examples from a single seed block on a single task.
learned_causal is fit jointly on a small training batch (eight examples) and may itself be undertrained; a null result for it must be treated cautiously, not as proof no learned rotation can work.
gradient_coordinate tests raw-coordinate sensitivity only, not distributed causal directions; it is not a strong causal baseline and must not be described as one.
Degeneracy diagnostics are computed only for the subset of examples where both full-space and fresh-in-basis optimization succeed; this subset can be small or empty at low ranks.
Causal-subspace and evaluation-protocol choices are fixed before this run; no data-dependent rank or metric selection after seeing outcomes.
